integrity: The proof is an analytic equality-support classification. Exact standard-library enumeration of all relevant vertex and support cases independently checks the finite algebraic premises. No separate external audit has been carried out.
scientific_limitations: The new result classifies the unordered maximizer locus in one fixed nine-vertex four-polytope. The numerical maximum and the vertex maximizers are known; the planar pentagon sliding phenomenon is also known. Historical priority is provisional; no other polytopes or stability law is treated.
title: Four disconnected circles of largest four-simplices in the orthogonal square–pentagon free sum
